lines: I intend to record this accurately. You stood with us when it mattered.
The account will say you came when the village needed help.
I saw people reach shelter because you held the road.
Your actions gave the bell-ringer time to warn the far houses.
The archive is intact, and so are the families who hid beside it.
I wrote down where the attack turned. Your name belongs there.
You did not wait for praise before stepping into danger.
The children know someone kept the square clear for them.
I watched you choose the village over an easy escape.
The facts are simple. Trouble came and you answered.
People will tell this with more drama later. I saw enough without adding any.
You gave our defenders room to regroup near the well.
The north path would have fallen if you had arrived later.
I have recorded losses before. Today I get to record who prevented them.
You kept the fighting away from a house full of frightened villagers.
No one looked brave when the bell rang. You acted anyway.
Your help is why several doors opened again this morning.
I will not reduce what you did to a polite thank-you.
The village remembers who runs toward the sound everyone else fears.
When this day becomes history, your part will remain clear.
